name: Moonstalker Fang
summary: Near Auberdine, travelers gather Moonstalker Fangs for Wizbang Cranktoggle's sampling devices. The teeth come from the moonstalkers of Darkshore.

sections.title: A Grinding Mechanism
sections.body: Moonstalker Fangs come from saber cats that hunt along Darkshore’s forest fringes. Their long teeth can shear flesh and bone. Wizbang Cranktoggle, an eccentric gnome tinkerer, uses them in a different way. North of Auberdine, near the bridge, Buzzbox 323 crushes the durable fangs to dust for his ecological surveys.

faq.q: Where do Moonstalker Fangs come from?
faq.answer: Moonstalker Fangs come from moonstalkers in Darkshore, including runts, adults, sires, matriarchs, and the prowler Shadowclaw.
Wizbang Cranktoggle needs six Moonstalker Fangs for Buzzbox 323, his automated monitoring device north of Auberdine near the river bridge.

faq.q: What happens to the fangs inside the machine?
faq.answer: Buzzbox 323's gears grind the hard fangs into fine dust for Wizbang's field experiments.

angles.text: As a gnome, you may recognize Wizbang Cranktoggle's remote communication devices as gnome engineering. His slurred speech and unusual sampling choices still raise eyebrows.
As a hunter, you need sharp senses to face moonstalkers, ambush predators that blend into Darkshore's dark canopy.
